name: vinyl-scrubber
title: Vinyl Scrubber
description: A media timeline shown as a photographic suitcase turntable rendered with three.js: the record turns with the position at 33⅓ rpm and a drag on it scratches back and forth, the tonearm follows the track, and the waveform strip under it is UI SDK's slider in seconds. The 3D scene draws in a worker after the controls paint, with a drawn turntable without WebGL. It controls an HTMLMediaElement or works controlled, with seek, play and pause for agents.

[data-slot=\"vinyl-platter\"].background: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 93%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35) 93.5%, transparent 95%), repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, #d9dce0 0 1.4deg, #6e737a 1.4deg 3deg), conic-gradient(from 30deg, #9ea3aa, #e7e9ec, #8f949b, #c7cbd0, #9ea3aa)

[data-slot=\"vinyl-record\"].background: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 36%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 36.5%, transparent 37.5%), radial-gradient(circle, transparent 61%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06) 61.4%, transparent 62.4%), radial-gradient(circle, transparent 79%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 79.4%, transparent 80.4%), repeating-radial-gradient(circle, #101012 0 1px, #19191c 1px 2px, #0b0b0d 2px 3px), #0b0b0d

[data-slot=\"vinyl-sheen\"].background: conic-gradient( from 0deg, transparent 0deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1) 30deg, transparent 60deg, transparent 180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08) 210deg, transparent 240deg )

[data-slot=\"vinyl-panel\"] [data-slot=\.transition: scale var(--transition-duration-micro) var(--ease-standard), background-color var(--transition-duration-micro) var(--ease-standard)

docs: `<VinylScrubber label media|(value duration onValueChange playing onPlayingChange) defaultValue defaultPlaying peaks step title subtitle disabled labels>`. With `media` (a ref to an `<audio>` or `<video>`) it follows the element's time, duration and playback and seeks, plays and pauses it; otherwise pass `value` and `duration`, or let it keep its own clock. One turn of the record is 1.8 s, as at 33⅓ rpm, so a scratch moves a little and the waveform takes the long jumps: arrows move `step` seconds (5), Page Up and Down 30, Home and End the ends. `peaks` (0 to 1) draw the waveform, the played part lit; without them it's a plain groove. `title` prints big on the record's red label and `subtitle` under it, in the theme's sans font. The play button is a UI SDK toggle, pressed while it plays. Agents call `seek(seconds or "m:ss")`, `play` and `pause`; a seek past the end or before the duration is known fails with why. The turntable is a three.js scene (`three` is a dependency) drawn into an OffscreenCanvas in a module worker (`vinyl-scrubber-worker.js`, which your bundler builds from `new URL(..., import.meta.url)`), or on the page where workers can't draw; it loads after the controls paint and fades in over a drawn turntable, which stays on the server, without WebGL and when the context is lost. A drag that starts on the record, as seen in perspective, scratches by the angle around the spindle. It draws once per change, and every frame only while it plays, in view and without reduced motion; the waveform and playhead follow the same position.
